title: Cornerstone Fact Envelope
description: Canonical schema for a fact written to Cornerstone memory. Validated at MC-3 (schema gate). Status and supersession are derived from Zep's native temporal model per MC-5 and are NOT envelope fields.

type.description: What kind of memory this is. Maps to Zep edge type (fact_name) — drives first-class filtering.

authority.description: The level of decision authority that produced this memory.

author.description: Identifier of the principal who wrote the fact. Email for humans, agent name for agents (though MC-2 forbids direct agent writes in slice-1).

client.description: Client scope. Use the literal string 'agency' for agency-wide facts; a client slug (lowercase, kebab-case) for client-specific facts. Never null. (See MC-6 reconciliation Q4.)

topic.description: The queryable subject of the fact. ONE topic per fact (MC-4). Stable across supersession (MC-5): superseded versions of the same fact share the same (client, topic). kebab-case.

source.description: Where the fact came from. Free-form short identifier — manual, slack:<channel>, email, doc:<drive-id>, etc.

created.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this fact was written. Maps to Zep's valid_at on the edge.

key.description: Cornerstone domain key — the short stable identifier used for retrieval by exact key. Different from topic: topic is the SUBJECT, key is the SLOT. For most facts key == topic; they diverge when one topic has multiple slots (e.g. topic=q2-budget, key=q2-budget-amount vs q2-budget-approver).

value.description: The fact content. MUST include a temporal anchor (date, quarter, or 'as of' marker) per C01 R1. Plain text only.

x-zep-edge-attribute-mapping.comment: Zep edge_attributes has a hard cap of 10. The 9 envelope fields below fit; one slot reserved for future. fact_name (Zep edge type) is derived from `type`; valid_at is derived from `created`. status and supersedes are derived at read-time from Zep's native invalid_at filter (per MC-5).

status.description: Not stored. Derived from Zep edge state: 'current' if invalid_at is null or in the future; 'superseded' otherwise.
status.derivation: current iff edge.invalid_at IS NULL OR edge.invalid_at > now

supersedes_uuid.description: Not stored as a fact attribute. The supersession chain is reconstructed from the Cornerstone audit log (which records {action: 'supersede', old_edge_uuid, new_edge_uuid, ...}).
supersedes_uuid.derivation: join audit log by (client, topic) ordered by created DESC

x-validation-errors.MC3_SCHEMA_INVALID: Returned by api/routes/memory.py when payload fails this schema. Body includes field path, expected, actual.
